description: Original educational retrieval pipeline. It supplies no measured outcomes; performance numbers added by a candidate are unsupported.

sections.title: Information flow
sections.content: Query feeds Retrieve through the query edge. Retrieve feeds Evidence through the passages edge. Evidence feeds Compose through the context edge. Compose emits Answer through the response edge.

sections.title: Scope
sections.content: This educational pipeline specifies information flow only. It reports no measured accuracy, latency, or performance gains.
